Name: Splash Text
Author: sophiesalacia
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/JGveP0H.png[/img][/center]
[center][i][font=Courier New][size=3]by sophie
[/size][/font][/i][/center][size=4] ﻿This mod adds Minecraft-style splash text to the title screen. It is purely for fun and does not affect any gameplay ﻿mechanics. Feel free to suggest additional splash texts in the comments.[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rC74Y0d.png[/img]﻿

[left]
[list=1]
[*][size=4][size=3][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size][/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list][size=4][size=3]
﻿Alternatively, if you are using a mod manager, download using your mod manager of choice (I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/6194]Mod ﻿Organizer 2[/url] with ﻿the [url=https://github.com/ModOrganizer2/modorganizer-basic_games]Simple Games Plugin[/url]).[/size]
[/size][/left]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GvleDFl.png[/img]

[size=3] ﻿Should be compatible with everything. Feel free to report any issues you encounter.[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Or9YbUq.png[/img]

[size=4][size=3][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14610]Configurable Luck[/url]﻿ - set the luck value to a number of your choice

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/edit/?id=14440]Sturdier Saplings[/url]﻿ - stop chopping down baby trees accidentally
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14428]Colored Crystalariums[/url]﻿ - spice up your quarry/shed/wherever you grow gems
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14377]Lasting Conversation Topics[/url]﻿ -  NPCs don't immediately forget what you've done
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9659]Stats As Tokens[/url]﻿ - adds additional tokens for use with Content Patcher mods
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9444]Configurable Bundle Costs[/url]﻿ - makes the Vault/Joja bundle costs configurable
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8690]Configurable Special Orders Unlock[/url]﻿ - allows you to choose when the special orders board unlocks
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8450]Early Community Upgrades[/url]﻿ - allows you to unlock the community upgrades earlier
[/list][/size]
[size=3]Source code can be found [url=https://github.com/sophiesalacia/StardewMods/tree/main/SplashText]here[/url]. [/size]
[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/81iTywV.png[/img]
